text:
lee: quick heads-up: I found another confusing case in the Go SDK generator stream around auth refresh + ctx cancel. Repro in sampleapp/generator/onboard-leak.go. When we cancel the caller ctx while a transport reconnect occurs, a reader goroutine can get stuck. Anyone seen this?

anya: yep, familiar pattern. The root is mixing user intent (ctx cancel) with transport lifecycle. If reconnect and shutdown both try to close/send on the same channel you get blocked sends.

morgan: short-term pragmatic fix: give the transport its own context and an `abandoned` atomic flag. Do not close shared channels from both the transporter and the shutdown path; centralize channel close to one place.

lee: minimal sketch I used locally:

```go
transportCtx, transportCancel := context.WithCancel(context.Background())
var abandoned atomic.Bool
out := make(chan Event)

// transport reader
go func() {
  defer transportCancel()
  for {
    select {
    case <-transportCtx.Done(): return
    case ev := <-recv:
      if abandoned.Load() { continue }
      out <- ev
    }
  }
}()

// on auth expiry
abandoned.Store(true)
transportCancel()
```

anya: ergonomics note: Go currently leans on ctx cancellation for stopping streams. Node/Python expose Abort/Resume primitives which are clearer for apps. For Go we should add explicit Abort() (doesn't cancel caller ctx) and a future Resume(token string).

morgan: also surface an AuthExpired event with an opaque resume_token so callers can decide to resume. Document that Resume may replay the last N events and recommend apps persist a SequenceID for dedupe.

ci-bot: :robot_face: nightly-ci detected a flaky test generator_stream_race_test; see https://ci/internal/issue/7321.

lee: action items: morgan -> small patch centralizing channel close + transportCtx; anya -> API sketch for Abort() + AuthExpired with resume_token; I'll add a deterministic unit test that races auth refresh + ctx cancel and attach it to the PR. Also update sampleapp/generator onboarding note to explain ctx cancel vs Abort.

morgan: will open PR today and include a tiny sample showing `abandoned` pattern so new users can copy it.

anya: I'll sync with Node/Python owners on resume_token shape so cross-SDK behavior is consistent.

lee: thanks all. This should reduce surprises for users onboarding streaming with auth refreshes. :thumbsup:
